description: Itemised total for one ceremony: the tier's fee for the day, travel beyond the included kilometres, witnesses supplied, booking fee and balance. Arithmetic is the same as the estimator on the prices page.

day.description: weekday = Monday to Thursday, weekend = Friday to Sunday

km.description: One-way road kilometres from Murwillumbah, if the place is not listed

place.description: One of the site's places, e.g. Byron Bay, Gold Coast, Scenic Rim, or a further-afield one such as Brisbane; or omit and give km

service.description: Service id or name, e.g. weddings, elopements, legals-only, funerals

tier.description: Tier name when the service has more than one; defaults to the first

name: bestceremonies_estimate
title: Estimate a ceremony's total
